{{Top|leg}}
'''Swoopchasers''' or '''swoopchase racers''' were [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] bike [[Swooper/Legends|riders]] who specialized in the [[swoopchasing]] discipline. Due to the variation in difficulty levels on an average swoopchasing course, accidents were common and the morality rate among swoopchasers was high.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
